# Flowlu

> > Flowlu is an all-in-one business management platform combining CRM, project management, task tracking, invoicing, and workflow automation for teams across multiple industries.

Flowlu provides integrated solutions for customer relationship management, project delivery, and financial operations. The platform serves marketing agencies, construction companies, IT teams, and consulting firms with features including Gantt charts, Kanban boards, time tracking, and automated workflows.

## Key Topics

- CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
- Project Management
- Kanban Boards
- Gantt Charts
- Task Management
- Workflow Automation
- Team Collaboration
- Invoicing & Billing
- Financial Management
- Agile Project Management
- Time Tracking
- Lead Management
- Sales Pipeline
- Knowledge Base
